flows:
Navigate to https://revoke.cash then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
Never press 'Revoke', 'Approve', 'Confirm', or any button that moves funds.
On the revoke.cash page, find the switch labelled 'Show all approvals' and flip it on.
Assert that the 'Show all approvals' switch is now on and that the approvals list or its visible text updates to show all approvals.

remark: click: Clicking Get Started to open the approval dashboard
wait: Waiting after checking the approval dashboard for the Show all approvals switch

summary:
The test expected the approval dashboard and its “Show all approvals” switch to be available without an account. This page needs an account context to show approval data, while the instructions prohibited obtaining that context by connecting a wallet.
Revise the test to use a safe preloaded read-only account/address or a mocked approval-data fixture, or change the objective to verify only the unauthenticated dashboard behavior.
one_liner: The run tried to verify an approvals-only switch without an account, even though connecting an account was forbidden.
reason: The dashboard shows no such switch or approvals list without an account, and connecting a wallet is prohibited.

verdict.root_cause: The test expected the approval dashboard and its “Show all approvals” switch to be available without an account. This page needs an account context to show approval data, while the instructions prohibited obtaining that context by connecting a wallet.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not cause a product failure. It only clicked the permitted “Get Started” entry point and did not connect a wallet or press any prohibited approval, confirmation, or revoke control. The failure came from an incompatible test state: the requested switch and list require account data, but the test forbade supplying an account.
